testResults.name: simulated-venue-and-simple-touch
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest tests/harness/venues/test_sim.py tests/harness/fills/test_simple_touch.py -q
testResults.result: 21 tests passed for market/limit/stop/stop-limit orders, crossing and resting behavior, stop arming, partial and non-fill decisions, cancellation, replacement, and bus-scheduled outcomes.

testResults.name: deterministic-fill-boundary
testResults.result: Decision-price and triggering-market snapshots are retained; worsening quotes do not improve fills; latency preserves deterministic event ordering; no wall-clock, random, or network access is used.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed.

decisions: SimpleTouch uses visible quote-side size to bound fills and does not treat a trade as a resting-limit fill; print qualification belongs to T092.
Venue commands are fire-and-forget while acknowledgements, reports, fills, cancellation, replacement, and expiry are scheduled through EventBus.
